title: 原来是同胞
text:
【故事复现】原来是同胞（上）
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听Freya慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Did the young man speak English?
问题：这个年轻人是说英语的吗？
• 词汇准备
• amusing 好笑的，有趣的
• experience 经历
• wave 招手
• lift 搭便车
• reply 回答
• language 语言
• journey 旅行
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
I had an amusing experience last year.
去年我有过一次有趣的经历。
After I had left a small village in the south of France, I drove on to the next town.
在离开法国南部的一个小村庄后，我继续行驶，前往下一个城镇。
On the way, a young man waved to me. I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
途中，一个年轻人向我招手。我把车停下，他向我提出要求搭车。
As soon as he had got into the car, I said good morning to him in French and he
replied in the same language.
他一上车，我就用法语向他问早上好，他也同样用法语回答我。
Apart from a few words, I do not know any French at all. Neither of us spoke
during the journey.
除了个别几个单词外，我根本不会法语。旅途中我们谁也没讲话。
I had nearly reached the town, when the young man suddenly said, very slowly,
“Do you speak English?”
就要到达那个镇时，那年轻人突然开了口，慢慢地说道: “你会讲英语吗?”
As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
我很快了解到，他自己就是个英国人！
第十一单元第二课【故事复现】原来是同胞（下）
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Whom did the writer give a lift to in the south of France last year?
2 Did they greet each other in English or in French?
3 Does the writer speak any French or not?
4 Did they sit in silence, or did they talk to each other?
5 What did the young man say at the end of the journey?
6 Was he English himself, or was he French?
Answer: The writer gave a lift to a young man in the south of France last year.
They greeted each other in French. Apart from a few words, the writer doesn't
speak any French. They sat in silence. At the end of the journey the young
man asked, “Do you speak English?” He was English himself.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1. What kind of car did he ____?
(a)drive
(b)drove
(c)driven
(d) driving
2. As soon as he had got into the car, I said good morning. I said good morning
____ he had got into the car.
(a)before
(b)a long time after
(c)just after
(d) a moment before
3. 'Good morning,' I ______.
(a)spoke
(b)talked
(c) told
(d) said
4. I speak a few words of French. I don't know _____ French.
(a)many
(b)much
(c)plenty of
(d) a little
5. Neither of us spoke. We ______.
(a)neither spoke
(b)either spoke
(c)both didn't speak
(d) neither didn't speak
6. On the way, a young man waved to me. This happened ______.
(a) before the writer's journey
(b) during the writer's journey
(c)after the writer's journey
(d) a long time ago
7. The young man waved to the writer. He ____ him.
(a)saluted
(b)greeted
(c)signaled to
(d) nodded
8. He asked for a lift. He was a _____.
(a)tramp
(b)hitch hiker
(c) passenger
(d) foreigner
9. He replied in French. He ____ the writer in French.
(a)responded
(b)answered
(c) returned
(d)remarked
10. The writer had ____ reached the town when the young man spoke.
(a)often
(b)almost
(c)sometimes
(d)just as
Key: 1a 2c 3d 4b 5c 6b 7c 8b 9b 10b
第十一单元 第三课
▶ 过去完成时的构成
过去完成时(the Past Perfect Tense)由“had+过去分词”构成，had用于任何人
称。
▶ 过去完成时的用法
▪ 表示过去某一时间或动作之前已经发生或完成的动作或存在的状态。句
中常用by, before, when, until等词引导的时间状语。它是以过去某一时间
为起点,所以过去完成时是一个相对的时态,表示的是过去的过去。只有
和过去某时间或某动作相比较时才能用到它。例如:
• Most of the guests had left when he arrived at the party.
当他到达晚会时，大多数客人已经离开了。
• When I was a child, I couldn’t watch TV until I had finished my
homework.
我小时候，要写完作业才可以看电视。
▪ 过去完成时还可表示过去某一时刻之前发生的动作或状态持续到过去某
个时间或持续下去，常与for, since等词连用。例如:
• When Jack arrived, he learned that Mary had been away for almost an
hour.
杰克到时得知玛丽已经离开快一个小时了。
▪ 用于并列句:一个并列句用的是过去式，如果另一个并列句表示的动作
早于过去式这一动作，这时需用过去完成时。例如:
• Jim flew home, but his father had already died.
吉姆乘飞机回家，但他父亲已经去世了。
▪ 在 before, after, as soon as等引导的从句中,由于这些连词本身已经表示出
时间先后，所以可以用过去时来代替过去完成时。例如:
• The thief legged as soon as he saw the police.
那小偷看见了警察后拔腿就跑。
• I found your coat after you left the house.
你离开房子之后，我发现了你的外衣。
▶ 过去完成时的特殊用法
▪ hope, expect, think, intend, mean(=intend), suppose, want等的过去完成时+
动词不定式，表示未曾实现的希望、打算或意图。例如:
• I had intended to come over to see you last night, but someone called me
and I couldn’t get away.
昨晚我本打算过来看望你，但有人打电话找我，我无法抽身。
• She had hoped to catch the last bus but found it was gone.
她原希望乘上最后一班公共汽车，却发现它开走了。
• They had wanted to help but couldn’t get there in time.
他们本想帮忙，但不能及时赶到那里。
• They had hoped to be able to arrive before eleven.
他们本来打算能在十一点之前到达。
注：也可以用was/were+不定式完成时表示过去安排的计划或意愿未能实现。例
如:
• They were to have got married in January, but had to postpone the
wedding until October.
他们原来打算一月结婚,但不得不把婚礼推迟到十月举行。
比较: She was to leave the next day.她打算第二天离开。
She was to have left the next day.她本来打算第二天离开(但没有离开)。
▪ 过去完成时还常用于 “no sooner...than…”“hardly/scarcely/barely...when...”
这类句型中。为了强调，常将 no sooner, hardly, scarcely, barely置于句首
而采用倒装句式。例如:
• No sooner had I got back home than it began to rain.
我刚到家天就开始下雨了。
• Hardly had I left home when the telephone rang.
我刚离开家电话铃声就响了。
第十二单元第一课
